items.subject: Free help for families at Lakeside Chapel

args.subject: Free help for families at Lakeside Chapel
args.body:
Dear Pastor Kreloff,

CouponDonation turns donations into gift cards for groceries, medicine, rides and bills. Families apply for free in about 3 minutes.

Could Lakeside Chapel share this link with families who need help?
https://www.coupondonation.com/apply

And if you'd like to see how it works yourself, feel free to donate even a small amount at https://www.coupondonation.com/donate. You'll get tracking updates when it reaches the person in need, and you'll bring a small smile to someone's face.

Questions? Just reply. A real person will answer.

With gratitude,
The CouponDonation team
coupondonation.com

--
CouponDonation Inc., 300 Creek View Road, Suite 209, Newark, DE 19711
